title: Clear endings and a sense of farewell

captions.physics: Considering change and explaining a conclusion
captions.energy: Ending an account without remaining grounds
captions.emotions: Experiencing farewell to an earlier image

meaning: Your shared view can clearly end an earlier account while releasing it emotionally still takes time.
text: Ending an explanation and feeling farewell can happen at different speeds. The Hermit in the physical position of Ajna suggests considering a change and sharing a clear conclusion. Death in energy supports wanting to finish an account whose grounds have run out. Death in emotions experiences farewell to an earlier image. Her first role concerns freeing understanding from an exhausted explanation; her second concerns responding to its loss. You may already understand why the earlier picture no longer fits while it still feels emotionally significant.

For example, you examine drafts of a familiar drawing. After reflection, one person explains that its appealing form emerged through several different sketches. The idea of one instantaneous conception has to end. **A clear conclusion can precede farewell to an earlier image.** The documents provide an understandable connection, yet the attractive story of one flash of inspiration remains dear. You may miss its simplicity. This requires no renewed dispute with what you see: your view already draws on drafts while feeling still releases the old account.

The risk is treating continuing regret as a reason to postpone ending the account. Emotional response restores its standing as an equally grounded explanation although its basis has changed. Wanting to finish what is exhausted distinguishes knowledge from farewell: an earlier image can remain dear without determining what you consider understandable.
